 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi

CORAM:The Hon'ble Mr. Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh The Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ratnaker Bhengra
For the Petitioner: Mr. Piyush Poddar, Advocate For the Resp - State: M/s Jai Prakash, A.A.G., Rishi

31/ 18.01.2018 Learned A.A.G. Mr. Jai Prakash, Sr. Advocate seeks time to obtain latest status of the
matter relating to filling up of several posts under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and also
implementation of the Food Safety Standards in the State.
